text: Underway in this round five clash.
Abyss shouts immediately, claiming ownership of the loose ball in the centre circle.
Abyss breaks clean through the middle, three metres out with the net gaping!
Rovers keeping the pressure locked on, camping deep inside Athletic territory.
A venomous strike from Abyss two metres out, shaving the upright by mere inches.
Signal calls to cover behind.
Abyss surges three metres down the right channel.
A hurried clearance flies harmlessly wide of the target from deep.
Rovers maintain their squeeze in the final third, pinning the red shirts against the wall.
Abyss bundles it home from point-blank range! Rovers take a deserved one-nil lead!
Griezmatronn suddenly breaks away through the middle!
Striding into the final third now!
Griezmatronn slots it home! Synthetic Athletic level it instantly at one-all!
Signal shouts out to claim the restart from the centre spot.
Fired violently back into play by the corner push-panel on the far left.
Abyss powers straight towards goal.
Abyss finishes it from two metres out! DeepSeek Rovers regain the lead, two goals to one!
Flashing just wide from point-blank range!
Oh dear, Signal turns it into the Rovers net! An own goal squares it at two-two!
Griezmatronn simply folds over in midfield.
Abyss is tumbled over by Griezmatronn in a firm collision near the touchline.
Robodinho hit and sent sprawling.
Robodinho returns the favour, clattering Abyss down by the right wall.
Signal suddenly breaks loose down the right, clean through on goal!
Signal shoots from point-blank, scraping just wide of the post!
Abyss calls out loudly, demanding the ball over in the left channel.
Robodinho drives the magenta ball briskly up the left channel into midfield.
Robodinho strikes cleanly from two metres out! Synthetic Athletic lead three-two!
Robodinho inadvertently knocks it into their own net! It is three-three right on half time!
The buzzer sounds, power cuts out instantly, but the ball rolls freely.
The ball settles at three-all. Remember, the buzzer cuts power mid-stride, but any moving ball remains live and counts if it rolls over the line. A breathless half.
Abyss calls out immediately to claim possession as play resumes in midfield.
A whistling effort from deep that misses the mark by a fraction of a metre.
DeepSeek Rovers pressing high again, penning the red shirts in.
Robodinho clattered down by Abyss.
Teammates collide on the right, and Signal ends up flat on the turf.
Robodinho loses footing and topples over.
Abyss pounces on it, totally unattended down the right flank four metres out!
Signal bundles it home from the goal mouth! Rovers edge ahead, four-three!
Rovers maintain the pressure, swarming the Athletic half once again.
Signal shouts out to take command of the loose ball inside the final third.
Robodinho marches steadily along the left touchline, bringing play back into midfield.
A cracking effort from Robodinho two metres out, whizzing narrowly past the target!
The powered push-panel smacks the ball straight back off the left wall.
Robodinho scrambles it over from point-blank range! Four-four, and nothing between them!
Push-panel fires the ball clear.
Signal shouts out for it.
Griezmatronn clumsily hits the floor three metres out, but will be up shortly.
Abyss breaks through the middle with only two minutes remaining!
Abyss carries the ball seven metres across the centre circle as precious seconds tick away.
A blue-on-blue collision as Signal tumbles into Abyss.
They collide once more, and this time Abyss hits the deck on the touchline.
Robodinho charges clean on goal!
Robodinho lashes it into the net! Synthetic Athletic lead five-four with ninety seconds to go!
Griezmatronn calls out to manage the clearance out of the corner.
Abyss topples over awkwardly, a desperate blow for Rovers with fifty-nine seconds left.
Inches away from a late leveller, just clipping wide of the post!
Signal crashes into Robodinho with thirty seconds left, dumping the red shirt to the ground!
